title: ozothamnus thomsonii
intro: Ozothamnus thomsonii, commonly known as the Lemon Ironwood or Lemon-scented Paperbark, is a flowering plant native to Australia. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Ozothamnus thomsonii include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to possess antimicrobial and antioxidant activities.
